description: We are from Stip Highschool “Slavco Stojmenski” and we are interested in learning about planets and our solar system.
summary: We built a website that provides facts and  essential information about the planet Mars to intrigue and gather students or engineers interested  in learning  about the planet, possible future life on Mars and how that would look like, to help those interested to know where to start and push the idea and the concept out to the public. It also provides information about  what is needed to survive on Мars.
details: It provides users with essential facts and information about the planet Mars.It helps gather people like students and companies or engineers who want to see life be possible on Mars one day. The benefits of this website is to push the idea to as many people as possible, give examples and get started on how exactly those habitats need to look like. It also shows theoretical habitats that one day could become a reality and we need to start from somewhere.This shows our creativity through showcasing different problems that occur when needing to sustain life and we considered all those problems, like for example , water, food, electricity, radiation, shelter and more.
